```python
"""Reports CSV exporter."""

import csv
import io


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for col in cols:
        if not isinstance(col, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if col in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % (col,))
        seen.add(col)

    if not cols:
        return ""

    def _field(value):
        if value is None:
            return ""
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            value = str(value)
        if any(ch in value for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
            return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
        return value

    out = [_field(c) for c in cols] ... join with commas + \r\n
    for row in rows:
        out.append(",".join(_field(row.get(c, "")) for c in cols) + "\r\n")
    return "".join(out)
```
